excerpt: U.S. stocks dipped slightly on Wednesday, with tech shares declining, but Meta Platforms' gains limited the drop. The Fed and stock market received relief from cooling US jobs data. The June jobs report eased investor concerns.

content.introduction: U.S. stocks dipped slightly on Wednesday, with tech shares declining, but Meta Platforms' gains limited the drop. The Fed and stock market received relief from cooling US jobs data. The June jobs report eased investor concerns.
body: U.S. stocks finished slightly lower on Wednesday as technology shares fell, but gains in Meta Platforms limited the decline in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq.
Cooling US jobs data buys the Fed and stock market more time. A tepid June jobs report ​offers relief for U.S. equities just as investors had begun to worry.
